name: Band Wrist Curl
steps: Sit with the band pinned under your feet, palms up and forearms supported on your thighs.
Curl your hands toward your forearms while the band stretches.
Lower your hands past the edges of your knees.
tips: Keep your forearms flat on your thighs so only your wrists move.
Pause briefly at the top of each curl instead of bouncing the band.
